instruction: Write a helpful customer support response.
message: I was charged twice for my subscription this month.
response: I am sorry about the duplicate charge. Please check your billing page and send the two invoice IDs to support. If both charges are confirmed, we will issue a refund for the duplicate payment.

instruction: Write a helpful customer support response.
message: I forgot my password and cannot log in.
response: I can help with that. Please use the password reset link on the sign-in page. If you do not receive the email, check your spam folder and make sure you entered the email address linked to your account.

instruction: Write a helpful customer support response.
message: The app crashes whenever I upload a file.
response: I am sorry the app is crashing. Please update to the latest version, try a smaller file, and send us the file type, file size, device, and app version so we can investigate.
